name: K-Means Clustering
learningObjectives: Understand how K-Means iteratively finds cluster centers
Learn why initialization matters (K-Means++ vs random)
Interpret clustering quality metrics (inertia, silhouette score)
Recognize the impact of choosing different values of k
Understand when K-Means works well and when it struggles
Visualize how clusters evolve during the algorithm's iterations

controls.label: Number of Clusters (k)
controls.tooltip: Number of clusters to find. Try different values to see how it affects the results.

controls.label: Initialization Method
controls.tooltip: K-Means++ provides better initial centroids than random initialization.

controls.label: Max Iterations
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of iterations before stopping.

controls.label: Step-by-Step Mode
controls.tooltip: Enable to see how clusters evolve iteration by iteration.

visualizations.title: K-Means Clustering
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points colored by cluster assignment with centroids marked

visualizations.title: Inertia Over Iterations
visualizations.description: Line chart showing how inertia (within-cluster sum of squares) decreases during training

metrics.name: Inertia
metrics.description: Sum of squared distances from points to their cluster centroids (lower is better)

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measures how similar points are to their own cluster vs other clusters (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Cluster Sizes
metrics.description: Number of points assigned to each cluster
